path_integer_compatibility.matched: one or more Unicode decimal digits (general category Nd), including ASCII, Arabic-Indic and fullwidth forms, zero and values above signed 64-bit range; matched requests consume the public-bank rate limit and normalize digit values before lookup
path_integer_compatibility.in_range: zero through Long.MAX_VALUE enter the catalog query boundary
path_integer_compatibility.out_of_range: values above Long.MAX_VALUE return the fixed P4A-CATALOG-007 safe 500 without invoking catalog SQL
path_integer_compatibility.converter_404: negative and non-decimal-integer segments return compatibility 404 before the public-bank limiter and expose no rate-limit headers; numeric characters outside Unicode category Nd do not match

query_budget.scope: successful GET without exceptional authentication cleanup or snapshot refresh, which GET never initiates
query_budget.snapshot_state_check: folded into the listed business queries and does not add a SELECT
query_budget.viewer_relation: folded into the page/detail query through public_bank_plaza_viewer_state and does not add a SELECT
query_budget.paged_transaction: read-only REPEATABLE_READ so total and items observe one PostgreSQL snapshot

snapshot_freshness.fresh: complete snapshot age from 0 through 300 seconds; serve normally
snapshot_freshness.soft_stale: complete snapshot age greater than 300 and at most 900 seconds; serve the last complete snapshot, emit internal stale metrics, and do not alter the compatibility response
snapshot_freshness.hard_expired: complete snapshot age greater than 900 seconds; return the stable 503 snapshot-unavailable shape
snapshot_freshness.cold: no complete snapshot marker; return the stable 503 snapshot-unavailable shape
snapshot_freshness.partial: row data without a matching complete snapshot marker, wrong row counts or wrong digest is unavailable even when MAX(updated_at) appears recent
snapshot_freshness.readiness: not ready for cold, partial or hard-expired state
snapshot_freshness.visibility_events: publish, unpublish, delete, subject lock and equivalent visibility changes require immediate after-commit projection update or tombstone and may not wait for the soft/hard window

transaction_and_side_effects.background_refresh: one writer builds metrics, viewer state and the complete snapshot marker in one transaction
transaction_and_side_effects.background_coordination: Redis token lock is advisory; a PostgreSQL lock is the final single-writer boundary
transaction_and_side_effects.redis_lock_release: atomic compare-and-delete Lua using the acquisition token
transaction_and_side_effects.redis_lock_ttl: must exceed or be renewed beyond the measured refresh p99; expiration alone is not a fencing guarantee
transaction_and_side_effects.authentication_runtime_exception: target Session access/reconciliation or Flask Session exchange may write existing bounded authentication runtime state; these effects are not catalog business state

required_cases: all sort modes and deterministic tie breakers
board, source and normalized keyword filters
first, middle and beyond-last pages with exact total
distinct active user across more than one bank
fresh, soft-stale, hard-expired, cold and partial snapshots
concurrent refresh keeps the previous complete snapshot visible until commit
postgresql_compatibility.query_plan_evidence: capture EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) on bounded large fixtures; index use and absence of N+1 are contract evidence, while elapsed time is observational rather than a production SLA
postgresql_compatibility.extension_policy: do not require pg_trgm or another extension without explicit PostgreSQL 16/18 availability and restore evidence

business_invariants.statement: Every GET is database- and catalog-Redis-read-only and never initiates a refresh.
Anonymous and authenticated callers see the same catalog membership and ordering; authentication only enriches owner/relation fields.
Catalog GET SQL reads no source-owner table and no result-size-dependent query is allowed.
A valid page beyond the last item remains empty while preserving the exact filtered total.
An item is never served from a cold, partial or hard-expired snapshot, regardless of a recent row-level updated_at value.
A refresh commit exposes metrics, viewer state and completeness metadata atomically; readers observe either the prior complete version or the new complete version.
One identity active in multiple selected banks counts once in active_users_7d.
Visibility removal produces an immediate projection tombstone and cannot wait for periodic freshness expiry.
Every order has a deterministic source_id tie breaker and raw request values never become SQL fragments.
The same JDBC adapter contract passes on PostgreSQL 16.14 and 18.4.

items.title: public-bank GET never refreshes and cold or hard-expired snapshot returns stable 503

new_banks_7d and active_users_7d become true rolling seven-day measures instead of legacy current-day measures
